prompt: We just discovered unauthorized ITAR exports going back two years. Walk us through voluntary disclosure.
assertions: Describes the §127.12 VSD process: prompt initial notification to DDTC, thorough internal investigation, then a full report with facts, causes, remediation
States VSD is a significant mitigating factor and can result in no penalty, warning letter, or reduced civil penalty
Cites current penalty exposure: civil penalties up to ~$1.37M per violation (annually adjusted) and criminal exposure up to $1M/20 years per violation
Advises immediate steps: stop the violating activity, preserve records, consider disclosure counsel, review for related EAR/OFAC issues
Mentions submissions run through DDTC's DECCS platform (which deployed its Data Collection Modernization release in September 2026)
